svg.text: A live training session — from the Start screen to the debrief and back
Scope: the Start screen, the run controls (indicator · ▶ · ■ · Save) and the two questions. The map and panels are context — unchanged.
① IDLE — the Start screen (nothing loaded)
The editor UI waits behind the Start screen; run controls hidden. Recent = one click back
into a scenario, already in the mode you pick.
② EDIT — Recent ▸ Edit (or Open scenario)
The full editor appears; the pen says your edits are saved. Indicator ▾ → Live: asks Save /
③ LIVE · BRIEFING — loaded, paused at 0:00 (the exercise exists, recording armed)
Trainees mount and listen. ▶ starts the exercise (or the run setting 'Start immediately'
■ = END THE EXERCISE (a square). DAR looks back inside the run; Save = take a checkpoint
Results are computed: objectives close, each side's outcome is written (SR-116). Nothing
The objectives are evaluated and the results shown.
The world stays paused at the end for the debrief.
⑥ LIVE · ENDED — debrief on the frozen world (still Live, NOT an AAR)
Indicator = the checkered flag. ▶ greyed (the exercise is over). ■ CHANGED SHAPE: ⏏ Close
the session. Indicator ▾ offers what's next.
AAR — full replay of this exercise
⑦ ⏏ — the second question (really leaving Live)
The recording is kept. The cluster unloads Live and goes to Idle on every node.
Exercise 3 of Night attack is kept (12:58).
Every station returns to the Start screen.
⑧ IDLE again — repeat in one click
Recent ▸ Night attack ▸ Live = straight into the briefing (③), no scenario picking. Or Edit,
or another scenario, or AAR via Open recording.
+ the AAR of exercise 3: Open recording… (top of its list)
